## Problem

Who encounters this problem, and what are they trying to do?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful change and what success would look like.

## Alternatives

What can users do today, and why is it insufficient?

## Consent and data handling

Would this change collect or expose more data, affect visibility or permissions, or change retention/deletion? Explain how users remain informed and in control. Covert monitoring and permission evasion are out of scope.
